landing.step1Desc: Add the server and API token; it's stored encrypted on the server.
landing.step2Desc: Pull your forms and decide who can view, edit or validate each one.
landing.step3Desc: They view, edit and approve/reject, with their own review flow.
landing.tagline: Manage your KoboToolbox data and give your team access
landing.subtitle: KoboManager is the middle layer that lets your team view, edit and validate submissions — without a Kobo account and without exposing your API token.
landing.feat1Desc: Your team signs in with app users; they don't need a KoboToolbox account.
landing.feat2Desc: Approve or reject submissions; the status syncs both ways with Kobo's native validation.
landing.feat3Desc: The Kobo token lives encrypted on the server and never reaches the browser; accounts can be protected with a second factor (2FA) — enforceable by policy — and each form can set a retention window that purges older submissions from the local cache without touching the KoboToolbox archive.
landing.footer: KoboManager v{version} — a management layer for KoboToolbox
landing.feat4Desc: Decide which submissions each user sees —by a field value or by who submitted them—, not just which forms.
landing.moreSubtitle: Built for teams that need to share and analyze data without giving up control and security.
landing.feat5Desc: Share a form by link, no account required: optionally with a password, an expiry date and the same row- and column-level scope you apply to your team —even narrowed to approved-only or to specific teams. If you want, the link can include review progress or the sample panel by team (aggregates only), for field coordinators without an account.
landing.featQualityDesc: Catch rushed or fabricated interviews: too short or too long, overlapping in time with another by the same enumerator, with suspiciously short gaps between consecutive ones, with duplicate answers or the same GPS point repeated. You set the thresholds per form, the non-admissible ones go on hold in one click — in bulk or per team — and the list downloads as CSV or Excel. And if a team code comes in mistyped, the app catches it and guides you to fix it.
landing.featRiskDesc: Prioritise which enumerators to back-check by combining peer-relative signals — similarity across their own surveys, straight-lining, atypical distribution, digit preference, productivity, GPS and how much more quality control flags their work than their peers'. Never an opaque grade: each component is explained with its value and the team median. A signal to prioritise, not proof.
landing.featCommentsDesc: All of a form's review comments on one page, grouped by team and enumerator, with date, status, author and a link to the submission. See what's been commented without opening submissions one by one; filter by status and by text.
landing.featStatsDesc: Measure field performance by team and, within each one, by enumerator — you pick which form fields define the team and the enumerator: volume, quality (review status), duration and completeness. If your teams are organized by region or province, group them under that level with one click; and if initials are hand-typed with different spellings (“ABC”, “a.b.c”), they count as the same person. It respects scoping, so a team lead sees only their own.
landing.featSampleDesc: Compare what you received against the planned sample: targets per team and value (e.g. age range), shortfall and over-sampling at a glance, submissions pending review since the last cutoff, and a projected completion date per team at the current pace. Six presentations — from detail to traffic light — a meta-team grouped view (region, province…) and a plan with history, edited under its own permission.
landing.featSearchDesc: Search the text of submissions — matching option labels too, not just their codes — and combine per-field filters with AND/OR groups. Filters are remembered per form and also apply to exports.
landing.featColumnsDesc: Hide sensitive fields per user or mark them read-only, column by column. What's hidden never appears in the table, detail, statistics, search or export.
landing.featNotifyDesc: Hear about new submissions without watching the app: each user picks a per-form frequency — daily summary, hourly, or after each sync — and gets the alert by email and, if they want, as a notification on their phone or computer, even with the app closed. Always a count with a link, never the submission's content, and honoring what each person is allowed to see.
landing.featNotifyMockCaption: System notification — even with the app closed.
landing.selfHostTitle: It's free software: run your own instance
landing.selfHostBody: KoboManager is open source (AGPL-3.0). Deploy it on your own server at no cost, or support the project to keep it growing.
landing.disclaimer: KoboManager is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by KoboToolbox or Rakuten Kobo.
